lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
@nextcloud/files: 65,072 B in 18 modules on the memories-main page, of which its root dist/index.mjs is 28,807 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
6 delivered files carry no source map, so their bytes are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
2,120,126 B in 25 pieces of 11 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
74 files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
